Tier 0 elements constitute the base mesh, while tier 1, 2, and 3 elements are generated during refinement [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the refinement scheme generalizes Catmull-Clark rules into three distinct steps (tiers) labeled 0 to 3. It describes Tier 0 as the initial state ('tier 0 faces, means the faces of the mesh the exist at tier 0'). It then details how Tier 1 cells are formed by merging pyramids derived from Tier 0 cells. Subsequently, it explains that Tier 2 cells are created from Tier 1 cells (specifically at edges of the tier 0 mesh), and Tier 3 is the final step involving Tier 2 cells. Thus, Tier 0 constitutes the base, and Tiers 1, 2, and 3 are generated through the refinement process.
